correctness.rationale: The reduced Laplacian L_0(w) is affine and injective in every individual edge weight for the simple prism; strict concavity of log det L_0 gives uniqueness on connected allocations and transitive within-class prism automorphisms force the symmetric optimizer without assuming it. If all rungs or all cycle edges vanish the graph disconnects, and homogeneity forces full budget expenditure. Fourier symmetric/antisymmetric branches give tau=n*a^(2n-1)(T_n(1+b/a)-1). Differentiation yields S_n(t)-(2n-1)Q/(2P+Qt); H_n(t) is strictly decreasing since (2n-1)sum(t+d_k)^-2 > S_n(t)^2 by Cauchy--Schwarz, establishing the unique root and price limits. The finite Chebyshev resolvent S_n(t)=n*coth((n/2)acosh(1+t))/sqrt(t(t+2)) proves fixed-price and t~u/n^2 in Q=κn, with g(u)=coth(sqrt(u/2))/sqrt(2u)=κ/P; uniform analytic expansion and g' <0 give the stated 1/n^3 correction. Independently reconstructed exact sympy reduced-Laplacian determinants for n=3,4,5,6; agrees with Chebyshev tree polynomial. Bounded tests do not replace the analytic all-n proof.
